name: magisk_boot_patch
desc: [面具/高危] 沙箱打补丁boot镜像,仅副本不刷入
cmd: test -e $img || { echo NO_SUCH_IMAGE $img; exit 1; }; SB=/data/local/tmp/magisk_patch_auto; rm -rf $SB; mkdir -p $SB; cp -a /data/adb/magisk/. $SB/; cp -p $img $SB/in.img; cd $SB; export KEEPVERITY=false KEEPFORCEENCRYPT=false PATCHVBMETAFLAG=false RECOVERYMODE=false; sh ./boot_patch.sh in.img 2>&1 | tail -20; echo '--- 产物 ---'; ls -la new-boot.img 2>/dev/null && md5sum new-boot.img || echo PATCH_FAILED
